name: Google Flow Music
summary: Generative music platform, formerly Producer.ai (Riffusion), for creating and remixing songs.
description: Google Flow Music, previously Producer.ai and before that Riffusion, is a platform for creating, remixing and sharing songs with generative AI. Users chat with an assistant as in a studio session to produce full-length tracks, make music videos, create instruments and effects, and remix unreleased tracks. The Free plan has daily credit top-ups; paid plans are Starter at $6, Plus at $18 and Member at $48 per month.

howToUse.title: Open Google Flow Music
howToUse.description: Go to Google Flow Music and choose Get started, Sign up, or Log in. This platform, previously Producer.ai and before that Riffusion, is for creating, remixing, and sharing songs with generative AI.

howToUse.title: Chat through a studio session
howToUse.description: Chat with the assistant as in a studio session to produce full-length tracks. The page calls that chat Producer.

howToUse.title: Make videos, instruments, and remixes
howToUse.description: Make music videos, create instruments and effects, and remix unreleased tracks.

howToUse.title: Spend daily credits or a paid plan
howToUse.description: The Free plan has daily credit top-ups. Paid plans are Starter at $6, Plus at $18, and Member at $48 per month. The page says you can start with no credit card required.
